items.briefing:
The education sector is facing a serious cyber threat, with SonicWall reporting it is now the hardest-hit industry for cyber attacks. This is particularly relevant for registered training organisations like ours, as schools, TAFEs, and training providers are increasingly being targeted. Separately, a malware campaign linked to fake job lures from Cambodia is spreading a harmful program called SparkRAT — Australians should be cautious about unsolicited job offers or links received online.

If you work in education or training, stay alert to phishing emails and unexpected attachments. Always verify job offers or requests through official channels before clicking any links.
